Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Correct 0.0.1.1's GroundSit/Sit/Doze stage-numbering fix, which was itself wrong (confirmed against Lap Pillow's Dom/Sub options) — mod authors label these files by raw CPoseState, not a human-counted stage, so no adjustment is needed. Also force a Penumbra redraw when switching options while already in a pose loop, so the old animation doesn't keep playing.
